slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: Email, files, identities and applications across Microsoft 365, Azure and Google Workspace, including Google to Microsoft 365 moves. We also migrate from on premise servers and older hosted Exchange setups, which usually comes with the added job of deciding what genuinely needs to come with you and what has just been sitting there for a decade.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: How long does a migration take?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: For around 50 users, budget roughly seven days of actual configuration work from us. That is effort rather than calendar time. End to end it usually spans two to three weeks, because the bulk copy runs in the background while everyone keeps working, and the pilot group needs a few days of real use before the rest follow them across.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Will we lose data or have downtime?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Data integrity is validated throughout, and mail and files copy across in the background while your old system stays live, so people keep working during the move. The cutover itself is scheduled for a quiet window rather than the middle of a working day. Ixia Clinical moved ten users and over a terabyte from Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 without disruption to clinical work.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: What happens to our Google Docs and Sheets?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: They convert to Office formats on the way across. Straightforward documents come over cleanly. Anything with complex formatting, or an Apps Script behind it, needs checking afterwards, and heavily built spreadsheets sometimes want rebuilding rather than converting. We flag those during discovery so there are no surprises on the day.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: Can staff keep working during the migration?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: Yes, and that is the whole point of running it in stages. The old system stays live while data copies across in the background. The pilot group switches first, then everyone else, so at no point is the business waiting on a single big overnight cutover to succeed.

slots.label: Question 6
slots.default: Do you support us after go live?

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: Yes. The first week afterwards is when the real questions arrive, because that is when people hit the things a test plan never covers. We stay close during that period, and we can take on ongoing management once you are settled, as a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider with support and escalation coming direct from us.
